# haruhime: osu! skills for Claude

> The `haruhime` Claude Code plugin, from the `haruhimemoe` marketplace: skills from haruhime.moe, which makes osu! tools for players, mappers and hosts. They cover the osu! API v2, osu! BBCode and `@haruhimemoe/bbcode`, the content rules and official support for osu! tournaments, mappool data and pack keys, the hinai beatmap mirror, packs.haruhime.moe and its API, the pools.haruhime.moe pool builder, and the `@haruhimemoe/*` npm packages, including the shared UI components, the brand kit and the Next.js server kit. Skills only: no MCP server, hooks or commands. Each skill is short and links the source it summarizes. MIT license.

Install from Claude Code with `/plugin marketplace add haruhimemoe/claude-plugin`, then `/plugin install haruhime@haruhimemoe`. Each skill loads on its own when a request matches its description.

## Skills

- [osu-api-v2](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-api-v2/SKILL.md): Calling the osu! API v2: OAuth and scopes, rate limits, beatmaps, beatmapsets, star ratings with mods, and `@haruhimemoe/osu`, including its `/collections` reader and writer for osu!stable's `collection.db`.
- [osu-bbcode](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-bbcode/SKILL.md): osu! BBCode for userpages, forum posts and beatmap descriptions (the tags osu! reads, sizes, imagemaps, flags, gradients, the 60,000 character limit), and `@haruhimemoe/bbcode` to parse, render, lint, count and build it, templates included. bb.haruhime.moe, its editor, is live.
- [osu-mappool-content-rules](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-mappool-content-rules/SKILL.md): Whether a map may be used in an officially supported (badged) tournament, by hand or with `@haruhimemoe/compliance`.
- [osu-official-tournament-support](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-official-tournament-support/SKILL.md): Planning a tournament that wants badges and official support: eligibility, screening, badges, tools, and what to send the osu! team.
- [hinai-mirror](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/hinai-mirror/SKILL.md): Beatmap metadata and `.osz` downloads from mirror.hinamizawa.ai without osu! credentials, by hand or with `@haruhimemoe/hinai`: limits, errors, retries and etiquette.
- [osu-mappool-data](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-mappool-data/SKILL.md): A mappool in code: slots, custom slots and their mods, pasted pools, and pack keys (`pk1.` to `pk3.`), with `@haruhimemoe/pool` or in another language.
- [packs](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/packs/SKILL.md): Making, opening, sharing or downloading a mappool pack with packs.haruhime.moe, adding a pack to an osu! collection, and its API: keys and endpoints.
- [pools](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/pools/SKILL.md): Building an osu! tournament mappool on pools.haruhime.moe (in beta): sign-in, templates and slot targets, the editor (notes, previews, undo, export, recent changes, drag and drop), the map browser's mod lens, the summary, co-editors, visibility, the synced pack on packs and Start from this pool. Past pools from otdb, tournament hosts and community submissions as reference: search, map history, the check and sending a pool. No public API.
- [haruhimemoe-packages](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhimemoe-packages/SKILL.md): Which `@haruhimemoe/*` package or entry point does what (pool, osu, hinai, compliance, bbcode, ui, brand, next-kit), where each runs, which versions go together, and installing them.
- [haruhime-ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-ui/SKILL.md): Building a haruhime.moe tool's pages, or another Next.js page, with `@haruhimemoe/ui`: setup, the theme, which component fits, client vs server, accessibility.
- [haruhime-next-kit](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-next-kit/SKILL.md): A haruhime.moe-style Next.js app's server side with `@haruhimemoe/next-kit`: route helpers, rate limits and osu! budgets in MongoDB, env parsing, the MongoDB client, sign in with osu! through better-auth, and Vitest helpers.
- [haruhime-brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-brand/SKILL.md): The wordmark, icons, link preview, README banners and palette for haruhime.moe and its tools, with `@haruhimemoe/brand`.

## Reference files

- [osu-api-v2/client.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-api-v2/client.md): The `@haruhimemoe/osu` client's results, rate budget and errors.
- [osu-bbcode/tags.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-bbcode/tags.md): Every tag osu! reads with its forms and behavior, how block tags eat newlines, the imagemap line format and the limits.
- [hinai-mirror/client.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/hinai-mirror/client.md): The `@haruhimemoe/hinai` client's results, timeouts, the errors that aren't a `HinaiError`, and the `/testing` mocks.
- [osu-mappool-data/pack-key-format.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/osu-mappool-data/pack-key-format.md): A copy of the pack key spec from `@haruhimemoe/pool`, with every version's byte layout and the decoder rules.
- [packs/api.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/packs/api.md): A copy of the live packs API docs: keys, rate limits, errors, the pack object and its stats, every endpoint, the search index's fields and the API's changes.
- [haruhime-ui/components.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-ui/components.md): Which `@haruhimemoe/ui` component fits each job, with the version each one arrived in and which are client components.
- [haruhime-next-kit/seo.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-next-kit/seo.md): `@haruhimemoe/next-kit/seo` in detail: the metadata helpers, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD builders and llms.txt, where each haruhime site wires them, and the gotchas.
- [haruhime-brand/page-cards.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/haruhime-brand/page-cards.md): Per-page link previews with `ogCardSvg` and `ogCard`: when a page gets one, static at build or per request in a Node route, and `asciiText`.
- [pools/editor.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/pools/editor.md): The pools editor in detail: the `/new` templates, slot targets, slot notes, map previews, undo, export (IDs, `!mp` lines, CSV), Recent changes and drag and drop.
- [pools/search-links.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin/blob/main/plugins/haruhime/skills/pools/search-links.md): The map browser's `?browse=` link and what it shows, every pools.haruhime.moe search param with its values and bounds, the old-links rule, and example links.

## Related

- [haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://www.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The haruhime.moe site and its tools.
- [packs.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The packs pages, guides, public packs index and API.
- [haruhimemoe llms.txt](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/.github/blob/main/llms.txt): Every haruhimemoe tool and package.
- [@haruhimemoe/bbcode](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/bbcode#readme): Parse, render, lint and count osu! BBCode the way osu! does.
- [Component showcase](https://www.haruhime.moe/ui): Every `@haruhimemoe/ui` component in its states.
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://pools.haruhime.moe): Build an osu! tournament mappool, in beta. Past pools, from tournament hosts, community submissions and sources like otdb, are there as reference. It publishes past pools, and unlisted or public built pools with maps, to packs as packs owned by haruhime pools.
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/bKy9kjMV4y): The haruhime.moe Discord server, for questions and help.
